dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Diabetic striatopathy (non-ketotic hyperglycemic hemichorea) caused by poorly controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus presenting during hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state
Alternatives to consider:
1. Wilson's disease (would expect T2 hyperintensity, "face of the giant panda" sign, and younger onset)
2. Manganese deposition (e.g., from TPN or chronic liver disease – though liver disease denied)
3. Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (would expect cortical/limbic DWI changes and rapidly progressive dementia)
